source_title: Jay Group Opens 250,000-Sq-Ft 3PL Fulfillment Center in Houston, Texas, Expanding Its Coast-to-Coast Footprint
source_excerpt:
The new Houston, Texas fulfillment center gives the 3PL coast-to-coast reach, with 1 to 2 day ground delivery to more than 90% of U.S. consumers
HOUSTON , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Jay Group , a privately owned third-party logistics (3PL) provider with more than 60 years in omnichannel fulfillment, today announced the opening of a new 250,000-square-foot fulfillment center at 7677 Pinemont Dr, Houston, Texas. The facility makes Jay Group a nationwide 3PL operating its own fulfillment facilities in Pennsylvania, Nevada, and Texas, and enables 1 to 2 day ground delivery to more than 90% of U.S. consumers.
Why a 3PL Fulfillment Center in Houston, and why now
For over 60 years, Jay Group has been a trusted fulfillment partner for beauty, hygiene, nutraceutical, and lifestyle brands. As those brands expand into wholesale, retail, and new marketplaces, demand grows for faster, more cost-effective delivery nationwide. With company-operated fulfillment centers in Lancaster, PA (HQ), Mountville, PA, Reno, NV, and now Houston, TX, Jay Group's footprint spans the East, West, and Gulf Coasts, meaning lower shipping costs, faster delivery, and better customer experiences.
The Houston location also offers easy access to the Port of Houston for low-cost, all-water inbound delivery and a centralized point for retail distribution. Brands selling to Target can leverage Target's new Receive Center, opened in April 2026. The facility's material handling systems are built for efficient omnichannel fulfillment.
Full-service fulfillment and flexible storage in Houston
The Houston facility supports 7-day-a-week B2C and B2B omnichannel order fulfillment, subscription box programs, Amazon FBA, FBM, and SFP prep, advanced kitting and display assembly, contract packaging, and reverse logistics. Operations run on Manhattan Associates WMS paired with an AI-powered, real-time client portal and pre-built integrations to Shopify, NetSuite, Magento, WooCommerce, and more, backed by dedicated account management and discounted small-parcel rates across national carriers.
Houston, Texas storage capacity available now
For the 2026 to 2027 period, Jay Group is offering flexible storage at the Houston facility for brands that need space, whether or not they use Jay Group for fulfillment. As a brand-new, 250,000-square-foot facility, Houston has significant capacity available immediately, including bulk and pallet storage, rack and selective shelving, bin and shelf space, cross-docking, and buffer stock positioning. Options range from short-term seasonal and product-launch storage to long-term contract warehousing.
Jay Group is a privately owned 3PL with over 60 years of experience in omnichannel fulfillment. It owns and operates FDA-registered, ISO 27001-certified, GMP-compliant facilities across PA, NV, and TX, totaling just under 1,000,000 square feet, and has been named to the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies six times. Jay Group specializes in fulfillment for beauty, hygiene, nutraceutical, and lifestyle brands, delivering the compliance, accuracy, and scale that fast-growing brands require. Learn more at jaygroup.com .
